summary: The audit checks the 75 units, each letter graded with a C or better (at most 2 S-graded units count): 5 units in each of the six core categories, a primary pathway (20 units) and a secondary pathway (15 units), 5 more units from any pathway list (a petitioned course is moved in by hand), a WIM course and a capstone. For honors it checks INTNLREL 200A-C with a B or better and 8 units of INTNLREL 198 with a B+ or better, and counts at most 5 honors units toward the 75. Foreign language courses never count toward the 75 units, and at most 5 units of directed reading (INTNLREL 197) do. Checked by hand: that the primary and secondary pathways differ, one seminar or colloquium course, foreign language through second year or an exam, one quarter overseas, and up to 15 non-Stanford units with B- or better.
